title: Hosted Endpoint Seasonal Lane Planning & Catalog Bandwidth Allocation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a quarterly lane-based plan that allocates model catalog bandwidth and hosted endpoint capacity for expected seasonality. Deliverables: 1) lane definitions (Baseline, Surge, Reserve) with capacity commitments and SLO/rollback criteria; 2) model-catalog bandwidth matrix mapping model variants to lanes; 3) canary windows and fallback policies; 4) operational runbook and cost impact estimate. Decision principles: prioritize latency stability for P95 <= our SLO for paid tiers, preserve low-cost fallbacks for experimental/edge models, and minimize manual ops during peak events. KPIs: P95 latency, token cost per 1k requests, failed request rate during canary, time-to-failover. This ticket coordinates PM scope across Eng, Design, and Solutions; engineering owns autoscale implementation and cost model validation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Lane definitions documented and ratified by Eng/Design/Support. 2) Catalog bandwidth matrix uploaded to Confluence with per-model lane assignment. 3) Canary schedule and rollback criteria published; at least one canary rehearsal completed. 4) Cost delta estimate reviewed and signed off by Finance. 5) Playbook links added to hostedapi runbook and referenced in Console release notes.
